|errata_history=The Players Committee first published this Virtual card on an old-style slip (before its December 2006 remaster of the set). The sheet copy that survives is the February 2003 re-issue PDF; the date of the first release is unknown (the sheet gives the legal date 1 June 2002). Icons printed on the slip are written here in brackets ([Pilot], [Immune to Alter], [Immune to Sense], [Immune to Control]); ▲ and ▼ are printed as such. Versions of the Virtual Original card, in date order:
* '''Original''' ([[Imperial-Class Star Destroyer (V) (Virtual Set 2)]]): the Players Committee's Virtual Set #2 sheet (PDF made 3 February 2003, a February 2003 re-issue; legal date on the sheet 1 June 2002; first release date unknown). Full text: “May add 6 pilots and 4 TIEs. Has ship-docking capability. Deploys -3 to same location as a unique (•)Star Destroyer. Permanent pilot aboard provides ability of 1. May draw one battle destiny if not able to otherwise.”
* '''PC-E1''' (this page): the Players Committee remaster sheet (Virtual Set 2: Our Most Desperate Hour, official text as of 4 December 2006). Full text: “Deploys -3 to same location as a unique (•) Star Destroyer. May add 6 pilots and 4 TIEs. Permanent pilot provides ability of 1. Draws one battle destiny if unable to otherwise. [Ship-docking]” '''What changed:''' removed “May add 6 pilots and 4 TIEs. Has ship-docking capability.”; “(•)Star” → “(•) Star”; added “May add 6 pilots and 4 TIEs.”; removed “aboard”; “May draw” → “Draws”; “not able” → “unable”; added “[Ship-docking]”.
|sources=* [https://web.archive.org/web/20071024153738/http://www.swccgpc.com/Resources/VirtualCards2.pdf#page=4 VirtualCards2.pdf] (Players Committee Remaster sheet, Internet Archive 24 October 2007) — official text as of 4 December 2006; page 4, slip 36. Slip image and game text from this sheet.
* Lore and art: the printed Decipher card, [[Imperial-Class Star Destroyer]].
* Full-card remaster: [[Virtual Set 2: Our Most Desperate Hour#Cards|Virtual Set 2: Our Most Desperate Hour]] (fan reconstruction, 2026).
|hatnote=Earlier versions of this Virtual Original card: [[Imperial-Class Star Destroyer (V) (Virtual Set 2)]]. For the Decipher card this slip modifies, see [[Imperial-Class Star Destroyer]]. Code OVS2 · GEMP id 1102_36.
